# Multiple Doors, Latch Triggers & Shared Devices

Latches can now use several doors and choose what starts them, so a garage with three doors can stay occupied while any of them is open. Holds on a sensor's device are now listed under Hold & Latch too.

### New
- **Several doors per latch.** Pick one or more door sensors. With several, the room counts as closed only when all are closed, and open when any is open.
- **What starts the latch.** Choose between:
  - **New motion after the doors move into position** (recommended, and the default).
  - **Any motion, including motion still showing** when the doors move. Can latch an empty room if you leave quickly.
  - **The doors alone**, with no motion needed, e.g. a garage while any door is open.

### Changed
- **Clears at is now Hold ends.** Existing entities keep their entity IDs.
- **Add to the sensor's device** now lists the sensor's device under Hold & Latch as well. The device's name, area and other integrations aren't changed. Untick it and the hold is unlinked again.
- Latch screen wording updated for multiple doors.

### Upgrade notes
- Existing holds keep their door, and default to **New motion**, the same behaviour as before.
- Requires Home Assistant 2025.3 or later. Automated tests run on Home Assistant 2026.2.
- Update from **Settings → Updates**, then restart Home Assistant.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/sambarlick/Hold-Latch/compare/v0.4.0...v0.5.0
